headline_marked: [[Facebook and Instagram]] down for many users, Meta confirms
headline: Facebook and Instagram down for many users, Meta confirms
summary: Meta's suite of apps, including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, are experiencing widespread outages. The company is aware and working on a fix.
details: Users worldwide are reporting significant issues accessing Meta's popular social media platforms. Reports of outages for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp began spiking around 9 AM ET.
Andy Stone, Meta's Vice President of Communications, acknowledged the problems on X, stating, "we're aware people are currently having trouble accessing our services. We're working on it."
The extent of the outage is still being assessed, but initial reports suggest a broad impact across Meta's ecosystem. Functionality for some users on WhatsApp also appears to be limited.
caption:
Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp are down globally. Meta confirms it's aware and working on a fix.

Users worldwide are reporting significant issues accessing Meta's popular social media platforms. Reports of outages for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp began spiking around 9 AM ET.

Andy Stone, Meta's Vice President of Communications, acknowledged the problems on X, stating, "we're aware people are currently having trouble accessing our services. We're working on it."

The extent of the outage is still being assessed, but initial reports suggest a broad impact across Meta's ecosystem. Functionality for some users on WhatsApp also appears to be limited.

topic: nvidia AI data center storage servers
headline_marked: Wiwynn unveils SCADA server with [[2.9 PB of AI storage]] and PCIe 6.0
headline: Wiwynn unveils SCADA server with 2.9 PB of AI storage and PCIe 6.0
summary: This liquid-cooled server packs up to 96 E3.S SSDs, offering extreme I/O performance for AI training and inference workloads.
details: Wiwynn has showcased one of the industry's first Nvidia SCADA (SCaled Accelerated Data Access) servers, designed to meet the extreme data demands of AI data center workloads. These systems are crucial for handling massive models and datasets, serving as the backbone for high-throughput AI tasks.

The SCADA server can house up to 96 liquid-cooled E3.S SSDs, providing petabytes of storage. When configured with 96 Micron 9650 Pro 30.72 TB drives, it offers a staggering 2.949 PB of data capacity and boasts an aggregated random read speed of 528 million 4K IOPS.

Built on Nvidia's Vera CPU and featuring four RTX 6000 Blackwell GPUs, four PCIe 6.x switches, and four ConnectX-9 SuperNIC cards, the server is engineered for massive I/O performance. Its architecture allows GPUs to directly initiate and control storage I/O operations, bypassing traditional CPU bottlenecks.

This direct GPU access is vital for AI inference workloads like vector search and RAG, which require fine-grained random accesses with extreme parallelism. SCADA servers are part of Nvidia's Storage Next vision, aiming to make storage an extension of GPU memory for AI.

The Wiwynn SCADA server is an Nvidia MGX rack-compliant system in a 6RU form factor, with a maximum power consumption of 9 kW. All key components, including the 96 SSDs, are liquid-cooled to ensure consistent performance under high loads.
